CLAIM_2_CONFIRMED_sign_convention_is_now.severity: HIGH -- and this one is real, verified in the repo itself
CLAIM_2_CONFIRMED_sign_convention_is_now.claim_a: The corpus and the repo's own docs state: 'listed_spread is the book home number, favorite negative. mu_margin = -listed_spread.' Found verbatim at docs/predictions/research/2026-10-13/SKILL.md:22 and :48, and in CODING_AGENT_PROMPT_EXACT.md:18.
CLAIM_2_CONFIRMED_sign_convention_is_now.claim_b: nflverse spread_line is the AWAY team's number. Measured on the frozen filter: mu = +spread_line -> CRPS 7.154021; mu = -spread_line -> CRPS 10.435732. Cost of the flip: 3.281711.
CLAIM_2_CONFIRMED_sign_convention_is_now.additional_conflict: OFFICE_RESEARCH quotes Sports Engine and Glicko2 Audit.docx: 'residual = home_margin + listed_spread where listed spread is the bookmaker's home line (favorite < 0)'. That is the SAME convention as claim_a -- correct for a book feed, wrong for nflverse columns.
CLAIM_2_CONFIRMED_sign_convention_is_now.why_it_is_dangerous: The repo's own SKILL.md now teaches the convention that costs 3.28 CRPS on nflverse data. Any future agent following that skill will invert the prediction.
CLAIM_2_CONFIRMED_sign_convention_is_now.proof_row: 2017_01_KC_NE: spread_line +8.0, home 27, away 42, margin -15. KC (away) favoured by 8 and won by 15. mu=+8 vs realized -15 is the correct error; mu=-8 predicts the home team by 8 against a 15-point away win.
CLAIM_2_CONFIRMED_sign_convention_is_now.action: Any code adopting mu = -listed_spread MUST first assert which team the incoming spread refers to. See dfs/walk_forward/corpus_sign_convention.json.

conformal_small_sample_law.detail: n=5, alpha=0.10 -> inflation 1.08, k=ceil(6*0.90)=6 > n=5, so the interval is infinite or No-Bet. Clamping gives n/(n+1)=5/6 = 83.33% coverage, a 6.67% under-coverage defect. Minimum viable n=9. At n=500, k=451.
conformal_small_sample_law.source: Auditing Conformal Prediction, Small-Sample Calibration... docx
conformal_small_sample_law.why_it_matters: It means small-N calibration gates are structurally incapable of hitting nominal coverage. Directly relevant to the build plan's proposed bootstrap-resampled calibration gate.

vision_calibration_headline_failure.detail: 787 plays / 1,181,625 frames, mean RMSE 0.0956 m (median 0.0972, range 0.0681-0.1246) BUT 90% CI coverage 83.65% -- 476/787 plays below 0.85, 31/787 above 0.95, outside the [0.85,0.95] band.
vision_calibration_headline_failure.why_it_matters: The accuracy looks fine while the stated uncertainty is wrong. That is the same class of defect as the non-binding Brier floor: a good point estimate hiding a broken interval.

jacobian_covariance_fix.detail: R_field(u,v) = J(u,v) * R_pixel * J(u,v)^T + eps*I2 with eps=1e-6 m^2, det(J)=det(H)/w~^3, R_field scaling O(w~^-4). The remedy for far-sideline/end-zone under-coverage.

frozen_model_replay_clean.detail: 27-season replay, n=15,939: win rate 52.700% vs break-even 52.381% at -110, z=0.799, ROI -5.48%/unit, AUC 0.4965 (p=0.4113), lookahead errors 0.
frozen_model_replay_clean.why_it_matters: A leakage-free harness that reports a NEGATIVE result honestly. AUC 0.4965 is below chance. That is the baseline any new model must beat.

sgp_copula_fitted.detail: Student-t nu=4.0, 50,000 draws, empirical 8x8 matrix over 1,088 team-games; true joint 39.25% vs 30.98% independent (+26.68%, z=37.85); damped_LR = LR^(sqrt(rho)) with rho=0.6995, sqrt(rho)=0.8363 (1.2320 -> 1.1906).
sgp_copula_fitted.note: MITIGATES the skill's teaser finding rather than contradicting it: the corpus says a 28-point swing from correlation alone; here correlation moves a specific LR by 3.4%.

glicko2_tau_is_not_identified.detail: tau=0.5 is 'an assumed operational prior rather than an identified empirical parameter' -- likelihood flat over tau in [0.2, 1.2]. sigma=0.06 unidentifiable/inert. Idle-period rule phi'=sqrt(phi^2+sigma^2) is NOT wired (ratings2.py only iterates teams present in the active period's game records).
glicko2_tau_is_not_identified.source: Sports Engine and Glicko2 Audit docx
glicko2_tau_is_not_identified.cross_check: Independently confirmed this session: glicko2_parallel(r, rd, sigma, []) raises ZeroDivisionError, so a bye week CRASHES rather than passing through unadjusted. The idle rule itself reproduces exactly (RD 200 -> 200.27 / 201.08 / 204.57).
